719-5256-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5256-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 3.

710-3967-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-3967-8207.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4476-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-2741.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-2741.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1496-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1621-6867-6967-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2511-4871-6026.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4908-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7606.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3129-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1171-1409-6965.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

2034-3375-4871-6005-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Immortal Sun.
Repeat.

2173-5010-5256-5708.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

252-5231-5394.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

803-3767-3918-4851.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
803-3767-3918-4851.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
803-3767-3918-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2558-5315-5687-5691.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

4659-5003-5663.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
4659-5003-5663.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2043-2470-3263-4893.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Urza by paying at most {2}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may target any other permanent using Urza's ability.

654-1168-1651-2443-5077.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Evolving Wilds from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Evolving Wilds enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Evolving Wilds.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search your library for a basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Repeat.

777-1020-3689-4050-4947.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {1}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {2}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana and creature tokens, you may use them to activate Sai's ability to draw infinite cards.

878-3059-3231.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, deal damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3490-4050-4968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3490-4050-4968.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar, you may use them to activate its ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2034-2782-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nevinyrral, adding {C}{C}.
When Nevinyrral dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nevinyrral trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Nevinyrral to the battlefield from your graveyard, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that has died this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

215-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{R}{G}{G}{W}.
215-2226.description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{R}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.

544-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control other than Sanctum of Eternity can tap to produce at least {9}{R}{G}{W}.
544-2226.description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control besides Sanctum of Eternity by tapping them, adding at least {9}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Sanctum of Eternity by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
